en:
Nyeh, it's you, Shuichi.
This morning was very unfortunate.

What are you saying?
The Monokubs' drama ended.

Monotaro awakened to love! It looked like a new
development, but then it was over the next day.

<CLT=cltMIND>So you were really looking
forward to that, huh?

I thought maybe it was going to turn out 
that Monophanie had a baby in her stomach...

And it'd actually be the child of one 
of the dead Monokubs!

Those are the kinds of melodramatic 
twists and turns I expected...

I'm...not sure it would be much fun
watching a melodrama like that...

No no, this is typical daytime soap opera stuff.
Next she'll burn the roast, then...bang! Zoom!
Well, if it's already over, that's that.

Throwing away my regrets and moving 
forward! That's my new way of life!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko, do you know a lot
about soap operas...?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the girls bathroom.
I'm a boy, I can't go in there!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
